title: Pick List
summary: A two-list chooser with drag-and-drop, transfer controls, and reordering.
overview: Drag members by their handles between Available Members and Team Members or reorder them within either list. Select multiple members to drag them together, or use the transfer and reorder buttons for keyboard access. The layout stacks on narrow screens.

component.avoidWhen: Use a small checkbox group when the source has only a few items.

title: Carousel
summary: A dependency-free carousel with accessible controls, indicators, responsive multi-item layouts, and optional user-controlled autoplay.
overview: A carousel moves through related content while keeping controls, position, and keyboard interaction clear. Start with manual navigation; add looping, multiple visible items, or explicitly started rotation only when the content benefits from it.

component.useWhen: Use a carousel for a small, related sequence of content when showing one or a few items at a time materially improves the experience.
component.avoidWhen: Avoid carousels for essential content that should be visible at once, for long collections better handled by a list or grid, or when users need to compare items side by side.
